name: Weighted Pull-Up
steps: While standing, fasten the plate to a dip belt and check that its attachment is closed.
Take an overhand grip just outside shoulder width and settle into a straight-arm hang with the plate still.
Pull your chest smoothly upward by driving your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
Lower to a controlled hang, stand securely and detach the plate.
tips: Prevent the added plate from swinging between repetitions by pausing cleanly at the bottom hang.
Avoid craning your neck upward to clear the bar; pull through your lats and upper back.
